name: The Wondrous Wisdomball only offers and grants quests the player's own faction could actually take
contract: AscensionWisdomball.cpp lists a dungeon's quests by map alone and accepts them through Player::CanAddQuest (log space and source item only), skipping Player::SatisfyQuestRace. Blackfathom Deeps quests 1200 (AllowableRaces 1101, Alliance) and 6561 (AllowableRaces 690, Horde) are the same 'Blackfathom Villainy' objective for the two factions; a Horde character must never be offered or granted 1200.

steps.label: Obtain the companion, as a purchase would
Using the item teaches its summon
Summon the ball in Blackfathom Deeps
The cast produced a creature this Blood Elf owns
A Horde character is never offered the Alliance turn-in of Blackfathom Villainy
The ball still offers this Blood Elf the Horde turn-in of the same quest
Try to take the Alliance-only version anyway, as a hostile client would
The ball refuses it outright - it never enters the log
The character's own faction quest is granted
